name: atomic_commit
description: Read, preview, verify, commit and read back one file.

steps.purpose: Preview with commit=false and expected_sha256 from the read
Check candidate content against the cell contract; STAGED is not a completed edit
Repeat identical operation with commit=true and the preview source_sha256
Read back; perform the cell acceptance checks and record paths/hashes

limits: One file transaction, syntax checks only. Previews retained. No zero-drift or application-correctness guarantee.
